about.title: Who I am & how I work
body: I'm Kevin — a full-stack developer who aims to build technically clean software that actually holds up in production. I care about features, but I care more about architectures that grow with the product.
Whether it's a freelance engagement, a full-time role, or an existing team looking for focused reinforcement: I adapt and deliver — pragmatic, documented, maintainable.
If you're looking for someone who takes ownership and thinks along instead of just executing tickets, let's talk — as a partner for a specific project or as a team member for the long run.
